purpose: Define the canonical forward-before-capture per-step sequence for G-REC direct-pose geometry collection. This amendment is required because R5-B investigation (commit 95ac49a) conclusively demonstrated that body_xpos buffers may be stale after env.step(), causing up to 6.4mm position drift. Explicit sim.forward() before entity capture eliminates this drift and makes derived pose buffers deterministically consistent with qpos/qvel source state.

r5b_evidence.test: A/B/C triple-read on libero_10/task_00/state_15, 20 steps, 10 bodies
r5b_evidence.result: A→B: 24/200 body-step cases mismatch (stale read). B→C: 0/200 mismatch (forward is deterministic).
r5b_evidence.verdict: STALE_READ — env.step() does not refresh all body_xpos buffers. Fix: sim.forward() before pose recording.

per_step_sequence.step_0_initial_entry: After collector init contract (set_official_seed → env.seed → env.reset → set_init_state → 10×DUMMY_ACTION wait), the simulator is live and qpos/qvel are at the canonical initial state. body_xpos buffers MAY be stale from the final dummy env.step().
for_each_step: 1. sim.forward() — refresh ALL derived pose buffers (body_xpos, site_xpos, geom_xpos, body_xquat, site_xmat, geom_xmat) from current qpos/qvel source state
2. verify_source_state_stability — save qpos/qvel/act/time BEFORE forward, compare AFTER forward, fail if any mutation detected
3. capture_source_state — record qpos, qvel, act, sim.time from sim.data (these are the authoritative source state)
4. capture_entity_poses — read body_xpos/body_xquat (body_origin), site_xpos/site_xmat (site), geom_xpos/geom_xmat (geom_center) from sim.data for all relation-bound entities
5. optional_verification_forward — second sim.forward(), verify no source-state mutation and no entity pose change beyond machine epsilon (1e-15)
6. serialize_telemetry — write all captured data to episode record
7. get_action — run model inference to obtain next action (NOT part of capture, does not mutate sim state)
8. env.step(action) — advance simulator to next timestep
per_step_sequence.note: Step 5 (verification forward) is optional for production collection but MANDATORY for same-live gate evidence. Steps 1-4 and 7-8 are mandatory for all G-REC direct-pose collection.

quaternion_convention.source: collector mat_to_quat() produces wxyz from 3×3 rotation matrix
quaternion_convention.rationale: q and -q represent the same rotation. Using absolute dot product makes comparison sign-invariant.

validation_rules.nan_inf_rejection: Any NaN or Inf in position, quaternion, qpos, qvel, act, or time → immediate HOLD, episode rejected.
validation_rules.unknown_remains_unknown: Articulated/unsupported entities (e.g. white_cabinet_1_bottom_region, wooden_cabinet_1_top_region) must remain UNKNOWN. Never convert to negative, never guess body/geom fallback.
validation_rules.body_origin_vs_geometry_center: body_origin (body_xpos) and geometry_center (geom_xpos) are separate semantic kinds with separate thresholds. Never conflate.
validation_rules.relation_bound_entities_only: Only entities resolved via C1-V2 relation registry may be captured. No heuristic string-scan enumeration (e.g., 'all non-robot bodies').
validation_rules.fail_closed: Any threshold violation → non-zero exit code. No silent skip, no downgrade.

non_consumable_artifacts.pre_forward_poses: Any entity pose recorded WITHOUT explicit sim.forward() before capture is NON_CONSUMABLE for G-REC geometry purposes. This includes the entire fresh40 fallback canary batch at b5c7853.
non_consumable_artifacts.stale_read_episodes: Episodes where body_xpos was read without prior sim.forward() may contain position errors up to 6.4mm. These must never be used for Teacher label geometry or Student training.
non_consumable_artifacts.replacement_required: All G-REC consumable geometry must come from a corrected collector (this amendment, R5-C1) producing a new sealed root (R5-F).

chronology_requirement.rule: This amendment MUST be committed and pushed BEFORE any corrected collector execution.
chronology_requirement.evidence_chain: commit(amendment) → commit(corrected collector) → execute(collector) → seal(evidence). The amendment commit SHA appears in the collector's runtime provenance record.
chronology_requirement.no_post_hoc: Thresholds frozen here. No threshold adjustment after seeing results.
